decisions.summary: A question is a gm-review.jsonl row of kind question (owed|kept|cut, reason); make gm-escalated records KEEP/CUT; gm-review shows kept as decisions, owed apart as the session's.
decisions.why: FR-002: one command records escalation-check's verdict, both kept in the record; owed listed apart from decisions; FR-004 one source.

decisions.summary: held() keeps only the 'Held behind' waiting reading; an override's own Held flag or held key is no longer a decision.
decisions.why: FR-004 verbatim.

decisions.summary: for_gm accepted on every trigger kind; bundle text and round arbiter's contract say it is the one way to the GM, through escalation-check.
decisions.why: FR-001 'on every trigger kind'; FR-002/B one door.

decisions.summary: C's refusal is a case-insensitive regex set (the GM's to decide|call|question|decision, for the GM to, held for the GM, the GM must/should decide, GM's choice) in why/what without for_gm; tested on 335#2, 374#60 and 20 negatives.
decisions.why: FR-003: each of its four named phrasings (his call, his question, his to decide, held for him) is covered.

decisions.summary: Landing refusal in push_gates.py over the active feature's records; Stop check in escalation-hooks.sh reads kept questions with utc after the session's last GM message, named by row id.
decisions.why: FR-002: a feature with an owed question cannot land; 'kept since the GM last spoke' operationalizes 'named in that session's next final message', refused once.

decisions.summary: E(b): measure the bamboo/shelter batch first; the change is chosen from the replay and recorded as a decision before it is made.
decisions.why: FR-005 'measured first on the two replays, then fixed'. The chosen change will return as a changed block for review.

decisions.summary: E(a): measure first - the triage's TOUCHES and impl-drift's yield on the 0081 edit.
decisions.why: FR-005 'measured first on the two replays'.

decisions.summary: E(a): 'if the triage is already the per-passage scoping the GM asked for, the change is to the triage's own threshold for TOUCHES' (with T05 Approach 1 'claims the edited passage bears on' and T05 Done 'every DRIFTED claim the old route found still owed' as its lever).
decisions.why: NOT LEGITIMATE. FR-005(a) requires that a claim citing only passages the edit left unchanged is cleared mechanically, recorded as such, and that triage is owed only for claims whose cited passage changed. The branch keeps the triage running over every unchanged-passage claim and tunes a downstream threshold: on 385#0 the 217 claims would still be triaged for two bullets, i.e. per page, which is the thing E (claims invalidated per cited passage, not per page) exists to stop. Mechanical clearing is not impossible, not excluded by the GM's words, and does not defeat the purpose; 'if the triage is already what the GM asked for' completes his thought. 'Bears on' is the triage's semantic test, not citation. The plan should implement mechanical clearing and meet the no-defect rule by proof on the 0081 replay OR by stating and pricing what it lets through (the spec allows either); if T05 item 4's finding means the spec's premise is wrong, that goes to a spec amendment or make arbiter-ask, not a plan-side substitute.

decisions.summary: Every open row marked reviewed via make gm-reviewed with his 2026-10-26 words, feature by feature; 374#60, 385#40, 397#10 written as kept questions in their own features with the audit's escalation-check reason.
decisions.why: FR-006, FR-004 (residence gets a kept question), SC-005.

decisions.summary: Texts change with the code of the task that makes each true (T01-T03); T07 sweeps FR-007's search hits, each changed or recorded as needing none.
gm-review.jsonl stays the per-feature file; old rows read as before.
decisions.why: Constraint inside FR-002/FR-004; FR-001 leaves accepts and drifts unchanged.

decisions.summary: arbiter.jsonl unchanged; hour's continue-with-nothing rule kept; fix bookkeeping (open, done, declined) unchanged.
decisions.why: FR-001: every ruling still written to arbiter.jsonl; only the GM rows change.

decisions.summary: A refusal names the command that clears it; turn's end refused at most once per message.
decisions.why: FR-002 'refused once'; FR-007 names its cure.

decisions.summary: No check skipped on a pop-up whose own text changed.
decisions.why: FR-005 no-defect rule, the proof option.

decisions.summary: His words on every row cleared; nothing deleted.
decisions.why: FR-006 'marked reviewed'.

decisions.summary: The constitution's text changes under its own amendment rule.
decisions.why: FR-007 names the constitution among the texts.

decisions.summary: A question is a gm-review.jsonl row of kind question (owed|kept|cut); make gm-escalated records escalation-check's KEEP/CUT; gm-review shows kept as his decisions, owed as the session's.
decisions.why: FR-002's record, listing and one command, as written; B in the request.

decisions.summary: held() keeps only the 'Held behind' waiting reading of override flags; an override's own Held flag or held key is no longer a decision.
decisions.why: FR-004 verbatim; D in the request (the held-list bug).

decisions.summary: for_gm accepted on every trigger kind; bundle text and arbiter contract say it is the one way to the GM, and only what passes escalation-check.
decisions.why: FR-001 'on every trigger kind' and FR-002/FR-007; B and C in the request.

decisions.summary: C's refusal pattern: regexes for 'the GM's (to decide|call|question|decision)', 'for the GM to', 'held for the GM', 'the GM (must|should) decide', 'GM's choice', case-insensitive, without for_gm; tested on 335#2, 374#60 and 20 negatives.
decisions.why: Implements FR-003's refusal; C in the request names 'the GM's to decide', which D4 matches, and it is tested on the two audit rows that said it (335#2, 374#60). Limitation stated plainly: the pronoun forms FR-003 lists ('his call', 'his to decide', 'held for him') carry no 'GM' token and are not matched. Ruled within because FR-003's parenthetical reads as illustrating the meaning, rulings name 'the GM', and the mechanism choice does not narrow what the rule refuses in the recorded rows; adding the pronoun forms would close the gap (aside, not a finding).

decisions.summary: Landing refusal in push_gates.py over the active feature's records; Stop check in escalation-hooks.sh reads kept questions with utc after the session's last GM message.
decisions.why: FR-002's 'cannot land until judged' and 'named in the next final message, turn's end refused once'; placement only.

decisions.summary: E(b): measure the bamboo/shelter pop-up batch first; the change is chosen from what the replay shows and recorded as a decision before it is made.
decisions.why: FR-005 'measured first on the two replays, then fixed'; the later choice is itself a plan decision and comes back to this review.

decisions.summary: A claim owed only a triage because a page it cites changed while every block it rests on stands is cleared mechanically, without the triage, its row recording the clearing; a claim whose rested-on block changed stays owed impl-drift as today.
decisions.why: Within, provided a claim's `rests` blocks are its cited passages: T05 item 4 treats them so (a changed rested-on block owes impl-drift today, everything else a triage), so clearing the triage-only claims is FR-005(a)'s per-cited-passage clearing, recorded as such, as E asked ('per cited passage, not per page'). The round-1 threshold is gone. Keeping impl-drift for a changed rested-on block is today's stronger check, not a narrowing. Aside: a claim with an empty `rests` would clear vacuously; R3's price should count such claims.

decisions.summary: FR-005's no-defect rule met by stating and pricing what the clearing lets through (R3, from past triages: TOUCHES on unchanged passages later found DRIFTED or MISLABELED); a material price goes to make arbiter-ask before landing, not to a different mechanism.
decisions.why: FR-005's floor is 'stated and priced'; R3 states the price from today's triage yield (TOUCHES on unchanged passages later found DRIFTED or MISLABELED), which meets it. The make arbiter-ask route on a 'material' price is the plan's own addition beyond that floor and 'material' carries no number (a self-judged gate); additive, so not a narrowing. 'Not to a different mechanism' bars the threshold swap ruled NOT LEGITIMATE last round.

decisions.summary: Every open row marked reviewed with make gm-reviewed and the GM's words, feature by feature; the three written as kept questions in 374, 385, 397 with the audit's escalation-check reason.
decisions.why: FR-006 and the GM's answer ('after we have cleared the backlog ... the three ... open').

decisions.summary: Texts change with the code of the task that makes each true (T01-T03); T07 sweeps the rest of FR-007's search.
decisions.why: FR-007; ordering only.
